subject: Web Development
title: The Build Tool Trap
description: Learn The Build Tool Trap in one minute.

hook.text: Modern web development requires build tools. But the tools themselves became a problem.

buildup.text: Webpack configs grew to hundreds of lines. Setting up a project took longer than coding it.

discovery.text: Vite simplified everything with instant dev servers and sensible defaults.

twist.text: Vite works because it uses native ES modules in dev, skipping the bundling step entirely.

climax.text: The build tool trap taught the industry that developer experience is a feature, not a luxury.

punchline.text: The best config is the one you never write.

quiz.question: How does Vite achieve fast dev server startup?
